findings: A complete transmission is an assembly/system; final kind depends on the schema enum and taxonomy convention.
A complete transmission is an assembly/system; final kind depends on the schema enum and taxonomy convention.
Pressure Plate and Clutch Disc are distinct; صفحه کلاچ is ambiguous as a primary Persian label. Use a distinct term and definition.
کاسه ترمز is more explicit; کاسه چرخ may be colloquial. Validate audience and retain only as a labeled synonym if supported.
سنسور دور موتور is colloquial/incomplete; حسگر موقعیت میل‌لنگ is more technically explicit. Keep colloquial phrase as synonym if desired.
Stalling is unintended engine stoppage, not the act of switching the engine off.
Tensioner is broader than timing-belt tensioner; use a general label and contextual subtype.
Rolling-element and plain/journal bearings are distinct designs; use a parent concept with scoped subtypes or split entries.
Suspension strut is structural and provides damping; it is not synonymous with shock absorber or limited to MacPherson.
ایسییو is unclear; use consistent letter-name transliteration such as ای‌سی‌یو and expand ECU.
Transmission fluid is a fluid/consumable; check whether schema supports fluid/material kind.
Brake fluid is a hydraulic working fluid/consumable; check schema enum.
Coolant is a service fluid/working medium; check schema enum.
Engine oil is a lubricant/consumable; check schema enum.
Refrigerant is a working fluid; check schema enum and documented taxonomy.
Related-term target absent from six-batch set; unresolved until checked against full canonical registry.
BCM belongs functionally to body electronics; category choice depends on primary-category policy and cross-tagging.
Condenser is ambiguous between electrical capacitor usage and automotive HVAC heat exchanger; qualify synonym/context.
Reflash and flashing overlap but may differ in scope; inspect full definitions and search behavior before synonym routing.
Uniform last_reviewed_at without reviewer/source trace is not proof of review; clarify as import/generation timestamp or require review provenance.
